_comment: Copy to config.json (one file per box, e.g. config-box2.json) and list the seats that box runs: seat = Linux user, token = collection token id, runtime = claude|codex, account = the label shown on the dashboard (seats sharing an account are grouped). Real configs are git-ignored. The backend reads this file from IMD_MONITOR_CONFIG (default /etc/imd-monitor/config.json); IMD_MONITOR_PORT overrides port.
_comment_watch: Watcher keys, used only on the one box that runs the heavy-work watcher. When watch_dir exists, /api/work, /api/watch and /api/network switch on (they return {enabled:false} otherwise) and the backend adds its extra public api.imd.fun reads (seat records, health, hourly steps, oracle and publication counts). watch_config = the watcher's config; its tokens list (every seat on every box) is the fleet on the Network tab, falling back to this box's workers. heavy_since = the date shown as 'tracked since' for non-oracle work; null = the date of the first heavy.jsonl line. heavy_baseline = optional rows {seat, key, accepted?, verdict?, outcome?, job} for heavy attempts recorded before the watcher existed (seat = the token id).
